# TopologyDistanceMetric

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A quantitative measure of structural dissimilarity between two circuit topologies, used to cluster individuals into species during evolutionary synthesis. Enables effective speciation in TCC by capturing meaningful differences in interconnect patterns, guiding the search toward distinct architectural regimes.
